title: Rails MVC Core
intro: Rails interview questions almost always open with the request lifecycle, because it touches every layer: the Rack protocol, the middleware stack, the router, the controller, the model, and the view or serializer. Interviewers use this question to understand whether a candidate can trace a real request end-to-end and explain what runs at each stage. This page covers the full lifecycle in the order it executes, the Rack protocol and why Rails is just a Rack app, the middleware stack and how to add or remove middleware, Zeitwerk autoloading and constant resolution, Rails engines, and the common scenario questions around request debugging — missing templates, 500s from middleware, and slow responses tracing back to a N+1 in the model layer.
